architecture.title: Sigstore stack
image & signature store
sub: Docker Registry v2 · Azure Container Registry
web UIs · registry browser & Rekor search

steps.title: GENERATE KEY
steps.body: RSA-2048 GPG key in a throw-away GNUPGHOME

steps.title: FETCH DIGEST
steps.body: Manually pull the image manifest sha256 from the registry

steps.title: DETACH-SIGN
steps.body: `gpg --detach-sign digest.txt` writes `digest.sig`

steps.title: VERIFY & PRAY
steps.body: Recipient must already have your pubkey · no Rekor · no identity

smallstep.title: SMALLSTEP CA · SHORT-LIVED CERTS
smallstep.intro: Cert expires before verify; Rekor's timestamp saves the day

steps.title: ISSUE CERT
steps.body: step-ca `workload-signer` provisioner mints a **2-min** X.509 cert

steps.title: COSIGN SIGN
steps.body: `cosign sign --certificate` binds image digest to the cert

steps.title: REKOR LOG
steps.body: Append-only entry with the cert + signing timestamp

steps.title: WAIT 130s
steps.body: Certificate **expires** on purpose before we verify

steps.title: VERIFY ✓
steps.body: Signature still valid; Rekor proves cert was good *at sign-time*

watch: no long-lived secret leaves the CA

sigstore.title: SIGSTORE · NO KEYS ON DISK
sigstore.intro: The ephemeral key never touches disk, only RAM, then gone

steps.title: SA TOKEN
steps.body: `kubectl create token` mints a 10-min OIDC JWT for `signing-sa`

steps.title: FULCIO CERT
steps.body: Fulcio issues a 10-min cert with **SAN URI** bound to the SA identity

steps.title: SIGN (RAM)
steps.body: Ephemeral keypair generated, used, **discarded**; never written

steps.title: REKOR
steps.body: Public transparency log entry recorded

steps.title: REGISTRY
steps.body: Sig + cert pushed as an OCI 1.1 referrer of the image

cicd.title: BUILD → SIGN ×2 → DEPLOY
cicd.intro: A simulated GitHub Actions run, both signing paths in one pipeline

steps.title: BUILD
steps.body: Rebuild image with current GIT_SHA + BUILD_TIME baked in

steps.title: PUSH
steps.body: Push to in-cluster registry (minikube) *or* ACR (AKS)

steps.title: SIGN ×2
steps.body: Smallstep CA cert **AND** Sigstore keyless, both attached as referrers

steps.title: VERIFY
steps.body: `cosign verify` on both signatures · fail-closed gate

steps.title: DEPLOY ✓
steps.body: Kyverno admits the Deployment; pod goes live

policy.title: KYVERNO BLOCKS UNSIGNED IMAGES
policy.intro: The moment of truth; webhook says NO to unsigned, YES to signed

steps.title: PATCH POLICY
steps.body: Inject live Fulcio root, Rekor pubkey + OIDC issuer into `require-image-signature`

steps.title: PUSH UNSIGNED
steps.body: Push a busybox-based image, **no signature attached**

steps.title: BLOCKED ✗
steps.body: `kubectl run` → rejected by admission webhook before the pod exists

steps.title: RE-SIGN
steps.body: `cosign sign` the demo app with the same keyless flow

steps.title: ADMITTED ✓
steps.body: Signed Deployment passes the webhook; pod schedules

attestation.title: ATTESTATIONS + AUDIT TRAIL
attestation.intro: The compliance close-out, full chain of custody, on demand

steps.title: BUILD PROVENANCE
steps.body: Assemble an in-toto SLSA-provenance predicate (source SHA, build time, builder ID)

steps.title: COSIGN ATTEST
steps.body: Keyless `cosign attest` attaches the attestation as an OCI 1.1 referrer

steps.title: REKOR LOG
steps.body: Entry kind `intoto` appended, same identity, same issuer

steps.title: VERIFY ATTEST
steps.body: `cosign verify-attestation` with cert-identity + issuer flags

steps.title: CISO REPORT
steps.body: Aggregate: source SHA · digest · sigs · attest · treeSize · PolicyReports
